---
title: "Render the codebook generator app using shiny live"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}

library(shinylive)
library(here)

# Set Shiny app directory
app_dir <- here()

# Set the output directory
output_dir <- "WebApp"

# Export the app
shinylive::export(app_dir, destdir = output_dir)
```
